all_words.explanation: An interpreter works inside a booth during conferences, so the two words describe the same working situation.
A walrus is a marine animal and has nothing to do with conference interpreting.
Interpreters wear headsets in the booth to hear the speaker, so the two appear together in discussions of interpreting equipment.
A cabbage is a vegetable and is unrelated to interpreting.
A soundproof booth is the standard term for the enclosed room where simultaneous interpreters work.
A hairpin is a small hair accessory and has no link with interpreting.

explanation: A booth is the enclosed room where interpreters sit during a conference; interpreter, headset and soundproof are linked to it, while walrus, cabbage and hairpin are not.
